svg.title: A holdover test against the ITU-T masks
svg.desc: A holdover test scored from a time-error record, from a real run of engine v0.40.0 on scenarios/holdover-test-example.toml (601 samples every 5 s). GNSS is removed by the operator at 600 s and restored at 2400 s; the time error drifts to 299 ns at the end of holdover, past the 100 ns budget after 675 s, and returns inside the 100 ns band 70 s after restoration. Verdicts: baseline masks PASS, holdover masks FAIL, holdover envelope FAIL, recovery RECOVERED. Measured against the mask, not an approval. The times are the operator's statement, not verified by Kshana. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
